spans.adaptation: Title, disclaimer and cast list. The cast descriptions became cast.description/faceDesign for Dr. Ananya (teal kurta under white coat), Meera (blue kurta) and Ravi (light green shirt); unstated details are recorded as manga supplements. The disclaimer that future referral-network experiences are vision drives the "WELBUK VISION" labels and vignette styling on 06-2 and 06-3.
Wide morning establishing shot of a neighbourhood Tamil Nadu clinic with Dr. Ananya welcoming patients; the source caption is lettered verbatim.
Paper registers, ringing phone and queue are drawn as props and background; Meera's line is kept verbatim but split into two balloons at the ellipsis so the list and the wish read as two breaths.
Ananya looks thoughtfully toward the reception desk; her line is kept verbatim in one balloon.

Laptop close-up with a generic, text-free setup form; source caption verbatim. A "WELBUK PRACTICE / for the clinic" label names the product that the source panel describes, so readers learn the first product role.
Ananya at the laptop considering team roles; line verbatim.
Meera with a staff phone showing an abstract screen; line verbatim plus a "WELBUK CARE / for clinic staff" label naming the source's staff app.
Friendly two-shot; Ananya's line verbatim, Meera answers with a nod.
Ravi arrives at reception, waving; line verbatim.
Meera asks for consent with an open-palm gesture; line verbatim, establishing consent before data entry.
Ravi agrees while Meera types; the monitor shows only blank fields so no identifying data appears. Line verbatim.
Meera confirms and gestures to the waiting chairs; line verbatim.
Consultation-room greeting, laptop closed aside; line verbatim.
Ravi states a routine concern; no diagnosis or medical advice is drawn or written. Line verbatim.
Ananya listens attentively with the laptop closed aside; the caption is verbatim and the closed laptop shows technology staying in the background.
Ananya discusses next steps with a reassuring gesture and no treatment details; line verbatim.
Meera introduces the Welbuk Health patient app on a phone; line verbatim.
Ravi holds a conceptual, text-free app screen with appointment and health icons; line verbatim plus a "WELBUK HEALTH / for patients" label naming the third product role.
Meera's line verbatim; the wording "what is available to you" is kept so no unlaunched features are implied.
Ravi leaves the clinic waving, reassured; caption verbatim.
Train-window transition to another city; the conditional caption ("may") is verbatim.
A conceptual connected clinic and specialist inside a pale-blue vignette, with a "WELBUK VISION" label and the source caption verbatim, so it is not read as a current feature.

Symbolic family scene with Ravi, his partner and child around an abstract family wellness app. The caption is verbatim; a repeated "WELBUK VISION" label and the same vignette keep it separate from current features (manga supplement).
Large closing group panel of Ananya, Meera and Ravi in the present, with the three product labels and the final caption verbatim.

Art direction applied as config.style, colorMode "color", readingDirection "left-to-right", varied panel rectangles, text-free panel art with separately composed English lettering, and quality.avoid entries against real patient data, medical claims and readable UI text.
